text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Sarcoidosis with neurosarcoidosis causing peripheral neuropathy.

The patient is a 50-year-old male with a chronic pruritic rash on the upper body and face, alongside symmetric numbness and tingling in the palms. While his agricultural work is noted, the combination of facial involvement and sensory neuropathy strongly suggests systemic granulomatous disease rather than simple occupational dermatitis or peripheral nerve compression. Have you noticed any shortness of breath, dry cough, or painful swelling around your eyes?
